name: 深层营润保湿沐浴露款
description: 冰蓝水感视觉语法，深层清洁与营润滋养的沐浴露套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, icy blue gradients #E8F1FA to #CFE4F7 for benefit and infographic screens, one deep ink-blue #223A5E close
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, airy cool cast, soft contact shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy wet-look water film and matte white pedestal surfaces
styleLock.iconSystem: glassy bubble and thin-line icons, single water-blue accent
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright pump-bottle hero angle and consistent scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool aquatic body-wash visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, icy blue #E8F1FA, water-blue accent #4A7BC4 and deep ink-blue text #223A5E; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key, airy cool cast and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; glassy bubble thin-line icon style; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright pump-bottle hero angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底泵瓶主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, upright pump bottle centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The upright pump bottle standing centered, straight-on eye-level view, full product and pump head visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the bottle. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, with no extra whitespace around the silhouette. Commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background tint, no cut-off pump head, no floating without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒传达深层清洁与营润滋养的核心利益，承接点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, bottle in the lower center, product-forward
shots.lighting: bright soft studio light from the front left, airy cool cast, soft contact shadow
shots.background: icy blue silky gradient #E8F1FA deepening to #CFE4F7
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper third reserved for the headline
shots.textZone: top-center headline with a small outlined pill label below it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} on an icy blue silky gradient background #E8F1FA flowing into #CFE4F7. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The upright pump bottle at a slight 3/4 hero angle in the lower center, occupying 50-60%, with generous negative space in the upper third. Bright soft studio light from the front left, airy cool cast, soft contact shadow. A headline in deep ink-blue #223A5E at the top center reading 「{selling_point_1}」 with a small outlined pill label below reading 「{callout_1}」. Negative: no efficacy or duration claims rendered as fact, no imported-origin claims, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand wordmark, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大干燥紧绷、冲洗不适等常见沐浴痛点，制造改变动机
shots.lighting: even flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: clean white #FFFFFF with four rounded light-blue cards #BBD7F2
shots.props: four rounded cards each topped with a small deep-blue round badge
shots.whitespace: even margins between the four cards, no extra whitespace inside cards
shots.textZone: one headline above the grid and four short captions under the cards
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point infographic: four rounded light-blue cards #BBD7F2 on clean white #FFFFFF, flat straight-on front-facing grid. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each card is topped with a small deep-blue round badge, holds a blank image area, and carries one short caption reading 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」 conveying common shower frustrations such as post-wash tightness, harsh rinse feel, excess foam and uncomfortable dryness; a headline in #223A5E above the grid reading 「{selling_point_2}」. Even flat lighting, even margins between cards. The card group occupies 45-55%. Negative: no real faces, no fabricated statistics, no invented ingredient percentages, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no garbled characters.

shots.intent: 用水分子球环绕的悬浮视觉暗示盈润机理，建立技术感
shots.camera: dynamic floating composition, photographed from a low angle looking up at the bottle suspended diagonally in mid-air
shots.lighting: luminous cool studio light with a gentle rim light, soft diffuse shadow far below
shots.background: luminous icy blue #CFE4F7 with a soft radial glow and transparent water-molecule spheres
shots.props: transparent glassy water-molecule spheres linked by thin strands orbiting behind the bottle
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the glow field fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Conceptual mechanism visual for {product}: the upright pump bottle floating diagonally in mid-air, photographed from a low angle looking up. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Transparent glassy water-molecule spheres linked by thin strands orbit behind the bottle. Luminous icy blue background #CFE4F7 with a soft radial glow, cool studio light with a gentle rim light on the bottle edge, a soft diffuse shadow far below grounding the composition. The product occupies 50-60%, with no extra whitespace. Negative: no chemical formulas or scientific notation text, no invented ingredient claims, no clutter, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 用分层剖面图解把滋养路径讲清楚，消除「洗不透」疑虑
shots.camera: straight-on frontal view of a layered cutaway diagram
shots.lighting: soft even light, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: stylized wavy skin layers rendered as smooth 3D sheets with pearl-bead textures and a translucent vertical stream
shots.whitespace: clean margins around the diagram, no extra whitespace in the label column
shots.textZone: right-side label column with four layer names and one headline on top
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic cutaway for {product}: stylized wavy skin layers in gradient blues rendered as smooth 3D sheets with pearl-bead textures, straight-on frontal view. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Four layer labels in the right column reading 「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」「{callout_8}」「{callout_9}」 with thin connector dots, and one headline in #223A5E on top reading 「{selling_point_3}」. Soft even light, background soft icy blue #E8F1FA, clean margins around the diagram. The diagram occupies 50-60%. Negative: no medical or clinical wording, no invented ingredient percentages, no anatomy errors highlighted, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no garbled characters.

shots.intent: 代入真实沐浴场景，让买家自我投射放松与滋润感
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level candid view across the bathtub rim
shots.lighting: soft natural window light from the left, 5500K, gentle steam, soft shadows on the water
shots.background: bright bathroom with sheer curtain, wall tone #F4F8FD
shots.props: a folded towel wrap on the shoulders and a small wooden bath tray at the frame edge, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the tub environment fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle bath scene: {product} standing on the rim of a matte white bathtub, a person seen only from the shoulders down with a towel wrap, head and face fully out of frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid feel. Soft natural window light from the left, 5500K, gentle steam, soft shadows on the water. Bright bathroom background with sheer curtain, wall tone #F4F8FD. Props: a folded towel wrap and a small wooden tray, not covering the product. The product occupies 40-50%, with no extra whitespace. Negative: no recognizable face, no visible head, no deformed hands or fingers, no hands covering the product, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用透明精华球与编号标签具象化成分卖点，强化配方记忆点
shots.camera: photographed from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, tight zoom on the orb group
shots.lighting: bright soft diffused light with delicate highlights inside the glass orbs
shots.background: clean near-white #F7FAFE with soft rippled fabric shadow play
shots.props: three large transparent glassy serum orbs: one molecular bead cluster, one soft pink botanical bloom, one cluster of pale aqua bubbles
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, orbs dominate the frame
shots.textZone: large ghosted numerals 1, 2, 3 beside each orb with short captions
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce ingredient-feature flat lay for {product}: three large transparent glassy serum orbs arranged diagonally, photographed from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, tight zoom framing. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Inside the orbs sit one molecular bead cluster, one soft pink botanical bloom and one cluster of pale aqua bubbles, echoing the blurred pump-bottle silhouette of {product} at the frame corner. Bright soft diffused light with delicate highlights inside the glass, clean near-white background #F7FAFE with soft rippled fabric shadow play. Large ghosted numerals 1, 2, 3 beside each orb with short captions 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」. The orb group fills 55-60%, with no extra whitespace. Negative: no real brand ingredient names, no invented concentration or percentage figures, no clinical claims, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用微距泡沫质地证明清洁与亲肤体感，落到可感知细节
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the foam surface, shallow depth of field with foreground sharp
shots.lighting: soft skimming side light from the right revealing fine bubble texture
shots.props: dense creamy foam lathered across the back of a clean hand
shots.whitespace: minimal, the foam texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of dense fine foam lathered across the back of a clean hand, tight zoom on the bubble texture, with the blurred silhouette of {product} just visible at the top edge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foam ridges razor sharp and fine bubble texture visible. Soft skimming side light from the right revealing the foam texture, pale icy blue background #EEF4FB softly blurred. The foam detail fills 55-60% of the frame, with minimal whitespace. Negative: no recognizable face, no deformed fingers or fused hand shapes, no blurry subject, no plastic-looking foam, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用留白口碑卡位承接信任，实拍后由商家回填真实评价
shots.lighting: soft even lighting, clean and readable
shots.props: three blank white review cards arranged in a vertical rhythm
shots.whitespace: generous whitespace inside each blank card reserved for real review screenshots
shots.textZone: one headline column on the right with three hashtag-style labels beside the blank cards
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce social-proof screen for {product}: three blank white review cards arranged in a vertical rhythm on airy light blue-grey #F4F8FC, flat straight-on layout. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each card keeps a generous blank image area on the left, and the right column carries a headline in #223A5E reading 「{selling_point_5}」 with three hashtag-style labels 「{callout_7}」「{callout_8}」「{callout_9}」. Soft even lighting. The card group occupies 45-55%. Negative: do NOT invent review text, ratings, sales counts or user avatars, no readable fake reviews, no QR codes, no member badges, no real profile photos, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 深色收口制造对比记忆点，用按钮位完成临门转化
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, upright bottle centered against the dark field
shots.lighting: bright key light with a subtle rim light separating the bottle from the dark backdrop, soft contact shadow
shots.background: deep ink-blue #223A5E with a soft radial glow behind the bottle
shots.props: a rounded CTA button below the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space above and below the bottle for headline and button
shots.textZone: short white headline above the product and a rounded CTA button below it
shots.promptTemplate: Promo closing shot of {product}: the upright pump bottle centered on a deep ink-blue #223A5E backdrop with a soft radial glow behind it, straight-on eye-level view. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright key light with a subtle rim light separating the bottle from the dark field, soft contact shadow. A short white headline above the bottle reading 「{selling_point_6}」 and a rounded CTA button below reading 「{callout_6}」, with generous negative space above and below. The product occupies 50-60%. Negative: no invented discounts, prices, countdowns or urgency claims, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo, no clutter.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 泵瓶立于冰蓝丝绸背景，标题为深层营润滋养美肤沐浴露与香氛 pill 标签；P2「沐浴为什么选择我们」三枚玻璃气泡卖点（温和滋润/清洁泡沫/原装进口）+ 产品顶置于圆台；P3-P4 红叉痛点卡四张（肌肤干燥/成分粗糙/泡沫过多）与续接标题；P5 瓶身斜悬浮于水分子球间的机理视觉；P6 肌肤四层波浪剖面图解（皮质层/角质层/肌底层/真皮层）；P7 面部模特特写屏（构图整体弃用）；P8 浴缸裹浴巾人物肩颈以下场景；P9 三颗编号成分球（分子串/粉色花朵/浅青气泡）；P10 泵瓶正面对称主图；P11 手背绵密泡沫微距 + 口碑板块标题；P12 三张买家秀留白卡 + 会员角标与二维码（已剥离）。品类判定：全套文案反复出现「沐浴露/沐浴乳」，泵瓶形态、浴缸场景、手背泡沫微距均为身体清洁硬证据，与夹名「洗护」泛称无关，判为 护肤个护/身体清洁/深层营润保湿沐浴露。已剥离：原品牌字标与英文水印字样、P7 模特面容（整屏弃用）、P8 人物头部、原文案原句、二维码与会员角标、买家秀头像；留香时长、原装进口等表述一律改为 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位，未写入任何成分含量、检测数据或规格数值。
